value.rationale: Tangential derivatives, rather than scalar samples, are a natural direct observable for vector field inverse problems. This theorem gives the complete sharp derivative-energy phase diagram for quadratic harmonics on a canonical antipodal cap mask in all dimensions, a surprising dimension-independent critical aperture, explicit multiplicities and a sharp instability coefficient. The scalar Slepian optimizer has a different ordering and a dimension-dependent transition; the gradient result is not merely a renamed scalar formula.
